title: Pesto alla Genovese
description: Basil, garlic, pine nuts, parmesan, and pecorino ground in a mortar with Ligurian olive oil. Enough for 400 g of pasta.
notes: Toss with trofie or linguine and a spoonful of the pasta water. It freezes well without the cheese; add that after thawing.

steps.text: Pound the garlic and salt in a mortar to a paste, then add the pine nuts and pound until creamy.
Add the basil leaves a handful at a time, grinding with a circular motion against the side rather than pounding.
steps.tip: Grinding tears the leaves and releases their oil without bruising them black. A blender works — pulse, and chill the bowl first.

steps.text: Work in the parmesan and pecorino, then the olive oil in a thin stream, until loose and glossy.
